tip: Kenya DPA 2019 §25 requires a documented lawful basis before processing any personal data — 'we've always done it this way' is not one of the six recognised grounds.
M-Pesa Daraja callback URLs must validate the request signature server-side. Never trust a callback payload just because it arrived on the whitelisted endpoint.
CBK's cloud computing guidance expects a documented exit strategy from every cloud provider before go-live — not after a contract dispute.
ISO 27001 Annex A 8.24 (cryptography) is where most Kenyan SME audits fail first: encryption keys stored beside the data they protect.
PCI-DSS Requirement 4.2 now mandates TLS 1.2 minimum for any network carrying cardholder data — TLS 1.0/1.1 fallback should be disabled at the load balancer, not the app.
A DPA-compliant privacy notice must name the actual retention period, not 'as long as necessary'. The ODPC has rejected notices for that phrase alone.
OWASP API Security Top 10's #1 risk — Broken Object Level Authorization — is the single most common finding in our East African fintech pentests.
Backup 3-2-1 isn't three copies of the same live database snapshot. It's three copies, two media types, one offsite and network-isolated from production.
Under Kenya DPA §43, a data breach affecting a data subject's rights must be reported to the ODPC within 72 hours of the controller becoming aware.
Rotate M-Pesa consumer keys and secrets on a fixed schedule, not only after a suspected compromise. Static long-lived API credentials are the top finding in our Daraja integration reviews.
A DR runbook that has never been executed in a live failover drill is a document, not a capability.
CBK expects regulated entities to classify cloud workloads by data sensitivity before choosing region and residency — not after.
ISO 27001 certification covers your ISMS scope statement — read it. Many Kenyan firms discover post-breach that the certified scope excluded the very system that was compromised.
OWASP's Injection risk still ranks in the Top 10 in 2026 largely because ORMs get bypassed for 'just one raw query' under deadline pressure.
A DPIA (Data Protection Impact Assessment) is mandatory under Kenya DPA before deploying any system that profiles data subjects at scale — including most credit-scoring and lead-routing tools.
PCI-DSS segmentation testing must be re-run after any material network change, not once a year on a fixed calendar date.
Immutable, write-once backup storage defeats ransomware that specifically targets backup repositories before encrypting production.
Data Protection Officer registration with the ODPC is mandatory for any entity processing data at the volume threshold defined under Kenya DPA — check your registration status, not just your policy.
OWASP's Security Misconfiguration category catches more East African cloud breaches than exploited zero-days — default credentials and open S3-equivalent buckets, mostly.
M-Pesa STK Push integrations should implement idempotency keys on the merchant side — Daraja retries can otherwise double-charge on network timeout.
ISO 27001's risk treatment plan needs an owner and a date per risk, not a shared spreadsheet nobody revisits after the certification audit.
CBK-supervised institutions must maintain data sovereignty evidence — know exactly which physical region every backup and DR replica actually lives in.
Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective are business decisions, not IT defaults. Get them signed off by the business owner before architecting the DR tier.
Kenya DPA consent must be as easy to withdraw as it was to give — a consent form with no corresponding withdrawal mechanism fails the standard.
OWASP's Cryptographic Failures risk is frequently a TLS certificate issue, not an algorithm issue — expired, self-signed, or wildcard-misused certs on internal services.
PCI-DSS scope reduction via tokenization is usually cheaper than compliance for the full cardholder data environment — evaluate it before your next audit cycle, not during it.
A cross-border data transfer under Kenya DPA requires either an adequacy finding or documented contractual safeguards — check this before selecting a foreign SaaS vendor for regulated data.
Test your backup restore, not just your backup job success rate. A green backup log has no bearing on whether the restore actually completes.
ISO 27001 Annex A 5.30 (ICT readiness for business continuity) is frequently audited separately from your DR plan — the two need to reference each other explicitly.
OWASP's Server-Side Request Forgery entry exists because internal M-Pesa and banking integrations often trust any URL a client supplies for a webhook.
CBK expects an annual third-party cloud risk assessment for supervised entities — not a one-time assessment at vendor onboarding.
